jobs.content:
<p>We are looking for a Strategy Architect with 5+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, IT strategy, and digital transformation. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining technology roadmaps, aligning business and IT strategies, and driving architecture initiatives that support organizational goals.<br><br>Key Responsibilities<br>Develop enterprise and technology strategies aligned with business objectives.<br>Design target-state architecture and transformation roadmaps.<br>Evaluate current technology landscape and recommend strategic improvements.<br>Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to define solution strategies.<br>Lead architecture governance, standards, and best practices.<br>Support cloud adoption, modernization, and digital transformation initiatives.<br>Identify technology risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities.</p>
<p>Required Skills<br>5+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, or IT Strategy.<br>Strong understanding of enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF or equivalent).<br>Experience in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI, or GCP) and hybrid environments.<br>Knowledge of application, infrastructure, security, and data architecture.<br>Strong stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills.<br>Experience in business case development, technology roadmaps, and governance</p>

jobs.content:
<p>We are looking for an experienced Tanzu Engineer with 5+ years of IT infrastructure and platform engineering experience, including hands-on expertise in VMware Tanzu and Kubernetes. The ideal candidate will be responsible for deploying, managing, and supporting container platforms while enabling cloud-native application delivery.<br><br>Key Responsibilities<br>Deploy, configure, and manage VMware Tanzu Kubernetes environments.<br>Administer Kubernetes clusters, namespaces, networking, and storage.<br>Automate platform deployment and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).<br>Monitor platform health, performance, and capacity.<br>Troubleshoot container, Kubernetes, and Tanzu platform issues.<br>Collaborate with DevOps and application teams to support CI/CD pipelines.<br>Implement platform security, backup, patching, and disaster recovery best practices.</p>
<p>Required Skills<br>5+ years of IT Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or DevOps experience.<br>Strong hands-on experience with VMware Tanzu and Kubernetes.<br>Experience with Docker, Helm, and container orchestration.<br>Knowledge of VMware vSphere, NSX, and vSAN is an advantage.<br>Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or scripting (Bash/Python).<br>Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.<br>Strong understanding of Linux administration, networking, and cloud-native technologies.</p>
